slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: ask
slots.about: the question over the levels, centred

slots.name: lead
slots.about: one line under the question: one tap logs, another tap changes it

slots.name: levels
slots.about: 3 to 7 levels, worst to best: id (1 up, in order), name, icon (a Tabler name); the middle one is drawn largest, better ones above, worse ones below

slots.name: logged_line
slots.about: the line once the day has a log; may read logged_name

slots.name: future_text
slots.about: shown when the day field holds a day still to come

slots.name: day_label
slots.about: the spoken label of the day field

slots.name: log
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: logs a level for the day, replacing that day's log

slots.name: pick_day
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: picks the day to log for

slots.name: back_today
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: puts the day back to today; the label is the button's words

empty.shows: no tile filled or ticked, done_row hidden

attention.shows: future_note, the levels dimmed and a tap does nothing

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, snappy, rise and swap
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the logged tile carries a tick and done_row names the level
